title: Planet Tweaks V2.4.1 ULTRA — Gemini 3.8 Flash & Autonomous System Management Tools
releaseNotes: Gemini 3.8 Flash Integration: Dynamic AI model switching defaulting to gemini-3.8-flash with intelligent failover. 25-Second HTTP Timeout: Upgraded timeout architecture preventing early dropouts on complex multi-tool queries and vision processing. Autonomous System Management Tools: Safe driver updating via winget, safe application uninstallation with ProtectedApps guard, bloatware process termination with ProtectedProcesses shield, and automated memory working-set boost. Resizable Studio Drawer: Drawer starts tall (480px) and features smooth mouse drag-resizing with customize mode toggle.
